final.summary: Two similar prior decisions disagree: one recorded a fix, the other judged its credential not exploitable for a reason specific to that service.

precedents.title: Hard-coded credential in the billing configuration
precedents.quote: Fixed: the billing password now comes from the vault agent at start-up.

precedents.title: Hard-coded credential in the search configuration
precedents.quote: Not exploitable: the search credential only opens a local read-only demo index.
